Robots

Meet our fleet

Find the perfect model for any use case. All robots navigate indoors & outdoors, self-charge, and integrate with doors, gates, and elevators.

Cartken Hauler
Heavy-duty outdoor AMR that tackles rough terrain and offers flexible compartment options.

Payload capacity: 660 lbs (300 kg)
Tugging capacity: 2,200 lbs (1000 kg)

Footprint: 38x22x40 in (98×55x102 cm)

Runtime: 16+ hours

Cartken Courier
Perfect for lightweight and secured deliveries. Very agile and maneuverable.

Payload capacity: 44 lbs (20 kg)
‍

Footprint: 33x20x24 in (83x51x62 cm)

Runtime: 13+ hours

Cartken Hauler (Temperature Control)
Designed to maintain stability of samples, compounds, and reagents regardless of external conditions.

Payload capacity: 660 lbs (300 kg)

Footprint: 38x22x40 in (98×55x102 cm)

Runtime: 16+ hours

Cartken Mover
(Coming soon)
Autonomous outdoor pallet truck automates pick and putaway material handling for heavy loads.

Payload capacity: 3,300 lbs (1500 kg)

Footprint: 90x40x67 in (230x127x170 cm)

Runtime: 8+ hours

What sets us apart

Technology

Building blocks of our autonomous delivery system

The core components that power Cartken autonomous mobile robots

Autonomy

Vehicle

Mapping

Teleoperation

Fleet Manager

Cartken AMRs navigate autonomously using AI, camera-based perception, and sensor fusion.

Adaptive Navigation: Real-time obstacle detection ensures smooth movement in dynamic environments.

AI Optimization: Continuous learning enhances route efficiency and reliability.

Camera-First: Depth and color cameras provide precise, scalable automation without costly LiDAR.

Smart vehicle design with adaptable hardware for safe and efficient operations.

Customizable Hardware: Cargo options, temperature control, custom buttons, and more.

Navigation in tight spaces: Zero-point turning and precise maneuvering capability.

Human-Centric Safety: Safely navigate around people, seamlessly sharing footpaths while operating at walking speed.

Cartken AMRs navigate in predefined areas using HD maps for precise, reliable localization.

Human-Annotated HD Maps: Define safe driving corridors and prohibited zones for the robots to navigate.

No GPS needed: Camera vision-based system can operate in GPS-denied areas.

Flexible Routing: Allows easy adjustment of pickup, drop-off points, and delivery routes.

Cartken autonomous mobile robots can notify remote human operators in edge cases, ensuring the highest level of operational reliability.

Instant Override: Operators can override the autonomous system anytime via LTE/4G.

Edge Case Assistance: Human support helps navigate complex obstacles and restricted areas.

Safe Intersections: Robots pause at mapped crossings until given human approval.

Seamlessly manage your robot fleet with our web-based application

Centralized Control: Place orders, track ETAs, track robot locations, monitor battery life.

Interoperability: Integrate and manage multi-vendor robots under one Fleet Management System for greater flexibility. Support for VDA5050.

Performance Analytics: Analyze KPIs like delivery volume, average time, pickup/drop-off frequency, and demand trends.
